title: WITH GOD ALL THINGS
ARE POSSIBLE
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon

scenes.a: If that wall in front of your plans feels completely impossible today, stop right here.
Jesus looked at them and said, With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.
Lord, in this midday heat, we confess our strength is empty.
The problem before us looks too heavy, the path too steep, and our wisdom too small.
Yet You hold the ends of the earth and speak life into hard places.
We yield our dead ends to Your living power.
Take what we cannot fix and work Your holy will. Grant us quiet trust right where we are.
